title: Rapid Quote Contract Gating & Indemnity Simulator
creator: Sofia Chen
description:
Goal: Build a lightweight decisioning and simulation tool that lets Sales and Pricing quickly evaluate contract redline risk and recommended concession pathways during quote windows. The tool will sit in the Sales quoting UI and expose an indemnity/liability gating score, suggested redline edits (auto-fill safe alternatives), and a visibility flag for Legal escalation.

Success metrics: reduce time-to-approve for standard enterprise quotes from avg 5 business days to <= 2 business days; decrease Legal-review volume for Tier-1 quotes by 30%; achieve >90% alignment between simulator-recommendations and Legal decisions in a 6-week pilot.

Scope (in): prototype a rules+scoring engine for MSA/DPA redline patterns (indemnity caps, carve-outs, escrow, data residency clauses), UI wireframes for Sales flow, integration with Contract Intake API for auto-populating customer and SKU data, and a lightweight simulation endpoint for bulk-simulating concessions to quantify revenue impact.

Scope (out): full automated signature/workflow, billing integration, or replacing Legal for non-standard large-deal escalations.

Approach: 1) Workshop with Legal to codify redline heuristics and tiering; 2) Implement scoring engine (config-driven rules + weighted signals from customer risk attributes); 3) Build a Sales UI mock in Console with a contextual results panel and 'suggested edits' payload that can be copy-pasted into redline; 4) Run closed pilot with 5 AE teams and weekly calibration with Legal; 5) Roll to broader sales after calibration and add telemetry.

Acceptance criteria: scoring engine produces an actionable gate (approve/needs-legal/escalate-to-legal) with >=80% precision on training set; UI surfaces suggested edits for the 6 most-common redlines; telemetry emits per-quote decision and reason codes to Console.

Risks & mitigations: 1) Over-simplification of legal nuance — mitigate by keeping human-in-loop and conservative gating thresholds in pilot. 2) Sales bypassing simulator — require soft-block policy and in-UI explanation. 3) Data leakage from redline examples — scrub all PII and store example patterns only.

Stakeholders: Legal (primary reviewers), Pricing, Sales Ops, Engineering (Contracts API), DevRel for rollout docs.

Next steps: schedule legal heuristics workshop (done), prototype scoring spec (this ticket), handoff to ENG for a 2-sprint implementation, and prepare pilot cohort and evaluation plan.
